thread:
tim: Deployed release v2.14.3 to prod (us-west). Canary at 20% for ~10m then pushed to 100%. rolling image: registry.redwood.ai/release/v2.14.3@sha256:9f2a
molly: nice, who handled the canary checks?
raj: I kicked off the canary, checked 1) pod restarts, 2) 95p latency, 3) 5xx rate in dashboards. All green except a small error bump on /embed endpoint (~0.02% -> ~0.2%)
serena: saw the small bump too. Any logs?
raj: paste from logs:
```
[2026-03-17T15:18:01Z] embed-service: WARN kv-cache miss for session=abcd123
[2026-03-17T15:18:03Z] embed-service: ERROR missing-input for input_id=null
```
tim: hmm - looks like a race in input validation under certain payloads. Is it reproducible in canary?
raj: I replayed the failing requests from the canary trace to staging, reprod once with 1/200 samples. Attached the request sample in #eng-ml (link) but short term we can add a guard
molly: for post-deploy: checklist run - could folks confirm these quickly?
- kubectl rollout status
- curl health endpoint
- basic prompt path smoke (prompt -> generate -> embed)
- metrics check (errors, latency P95)
serena: running now. `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/embed-service` -> "deployment \"embed-service\" successfully rolled out"
serena: health: `curl -sS https://api-us-west.redwood.ai/health | jq .status` -> "ok"
raj: did a quick prompt -> embed -> generate flow locally against the new canary host: one failure out of 300. Noted input payload had empty metadata array which used to be tolerated
molly: can we hotfix with a quick validation guard before full rollback? Tim, Raj, can you coordinate?
tim: agree. Patch plan: add defensive check in embed-service to return 400 for missing input_id or coerce to empty string. Deploy as v2.14.3-hotfix.
raj: I have a small change ready, unit tests pass. Pushing now.
```
git checkout -b hotfix/embed-validate
git commit -m "guard: validate input_id before processing"
git push && trigger deploy tool
```
deploy-bot: build started for v2.14.3-hotfix (id: 2765437001)
deploy-bot: canary deploy at 10% started
molly: I'll monitor metrics and error stream. Set alert if 5xx > 0.1% for 2m
serena: logs look clean so far, no new ERRORs
raj: canary results: 0 fails in 400 requests. P95 latency unchanged.
deploy-bot: canary auto-promote -> 100% (completed)
tim: hotfix promoted. rolling back not needed. Please run the smoke checklist again in prod.
molly: re-running quick smoke:
- rollout status: ok
- health: ok
- sample prompt flow: ok (embedded & generated text returned)
- metrics: errors back to baseline (0.02%), P95 steady
serena: double-checked downstream cache hits, KV cache warmup looks normal
raj: I'll add a small regression test to the embed test set to catch empty metadata/input_id cases
molly: awesome. For the release notes: note that v2.14.3 contains small input validation hotfix targeted at embed-service. No rollback. Ops: roll forward completed at 15:22 PDT.
serena: thumbs up :thumbsup:
tim: thanks all. Closing the deploy thread. If anyone sees anything odd, ping here or tag @oncall
molly: noted. leaving a short postmortem card for the tiny regression in the release board.
raj: thanks — will follow up with a short writeup and the test PR link.
